podcast.body: Cyndi Lauper's solo debut LP was released in the second half of 1983, just weeks apart from Madonna's self-titled debut album. By the end of 1984, this album had made history by spawning four top five hits, making Lauper the first woman to achieve this feat from a single album. "Released their solo debut LPs, she's so unusual and Madonna, respectively, just weeks apart in the second half of 1983."

podcast.body: This album was a "stellar" nominee for Album of the Year at the 1985 Grammy Awards, which recognized music from 1984 and late 1983. It ultimately lost to Lionel Richie's "Can't Slow Down." "among the stellar album of the year nominees were, Prince's Purple Rain, Cindy Loppers She's So Unusual, Bruce Springsteen's Born in the USA, and Tina Turner's Private Dancer."
